candidates.source_claim: For N normal in G with G=NH and N∩H={1}, conjugation α_h(n)=hnh⁻¹ gives an action of H on N, and Φ:N⋊_αH→G, (n,h)↦nh is an isomorphism carrying the canonical factors to N and H; conversely, such an action and isomorphism imply the internal product conditions.
candidates.why_warranted: A small diagram can make the coordinate decomposition g=nh and the two canonical factor maps visible together: n↦(n,1) and h↦(1,h), each followed by Φ to the corresponding inclusion into G. Showing the action by conjugation alongside the product convention can help readers track why the order nh, rather than hn, appears. This is useful but not needed to make the complete prose proof intelligible.
concrete_content_to_draw_or_check: Show Φ:N⋊_αH→G with Φ(n,h)=nh, and indicate that each g∈G has a unique factorization g=nh under G=NH and N∩H={1}.
Show the canonical inclusions i_N(n)=(n,1) and i_H(h)=(1,h), with Φ∘i_N equal to N↪G and Φ∘i_H equal to H↪G.
If the semidirect product multiplication is displayed, use (n,h)(n′,h′)=(nα_h(n′),hh′), where α_h(n′)=hn′h⁻¹; then Φ of the product is nhn′h′=Φ(n,h)Φ(n′,h′).
Distinguish the internal subgroups N,H≤G from the external coordinate factors N×{1},{1}×H in N⋊_αH.
correctness_checks: The action is a left action on N by automorphisms: α_h(n)=hnh⁻¹, and α_h∘α_{h′}=α_{hh′}. Normality of N is what ensures α_h(N)⊆N.
The external multiplication convention is (n,h)(n′,h′)=(nα_h(n′),hh′), matching the map (n,h)↦nh. Reversing the action order or mapping to hn would not match this convention in general.
Surjectivity follows from G=NH. If nh=n′h′, then n⁻¹n′=hh′⁻¹∈N∩H, so both sides are 1; this gives unique factorization and injectivity.
The factor maps are n↦(n,1) and h↦(1,h); under Φ these map to n and h in G, respectively.
No tensor balancing, coset indexing, or naturality assertion occurs in this construction and none should be added to the diagram.
candidates.why_not_confirmed: No mathematical or rendering defect was observed. A diagram could support orientation of the factorization and canonical inclusions, but it is optional teaching support; the current statement and proof already provide the maps and checks. Missing art alone does not establish a defect.
